label: Statistics Real Time 3 (empty)
purpose: Older (v3) real-time cube of request statistics (requests, response time and size by client, supplier, interface, request type, platform layer, outcome and zone). It has no data at all and must not be used; use Statistics Real Time Client (client requests) and Statistics Real Time Supplier (supplier requests) instead.
grain: One aggregated row of requests per request date and hour, client, supplier, interface, request type, platform layer, outcome, response-time band and zone (structure only: the cube holds no rows).
not_for: anything: the cube has no data
request statistics (Statistics Real Time Client (client requests) and Statistics Real Time Supplier (supplier requests))

coverage.note: No data at all: every measure is empty for every date (checked 16 October 2026). Do not use this cube; Statistics Real Time Client (client requests) and Statistics Real Time Supplier (supplier requests) have the same structure with data.

rules: Never query this cube: it has no data. Use Statistics Real Time Client (client requests) and Statistics Real Time Supplier (supplier requests).
'Fecha'[Fecha] and 'Date CET'[Date CET] repeat 'Calendario'[Fecha] and 'Calendar CET'[Date CET]; 'Calendar CET'[Ten Days CET] and the 'Calendario' *.Value columns are period keys, not day dates.
If it ever fills: the same request is counted once per 'Jerarquia' layer, so always filter one layer before counting requests.

review.question: Statistics Real Time 3 has no data at all (every measure empty). Remove it from the app?
options: Keep it listed but never pick it
review.why: It can only give empty answers; Statistics Real Time Client and Statistics Real Time Supplier have the same structure with current data.
